title: Candle flame frozen at the emitter's focal point

tellings.quote: Barry showed me he had one of the emitters it working. He put a lit little kitchen candle right at the focal point and he powered up the the reactor and the flame stopped flickering.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien spacecraft at a secret site called S4 in the Nevada desert in the late 1980s, tells of a demonstration by a co-worker named Barry Castilio. According to Lazar, Castilio had one of the craft's emitters, the parts that put out its field, working, set a lit kitchen candle at its focal point, and powered up the reactor, and the flame stopped flickering. If true, it would suggest the device could bend or freeze time or space around it.
